author: Aoife Murphy
text: Monika gave us a wonderful demo at home. She was patient, answered every question and the risotto we cooked together was delicious. Highly recommend!

author: Ciarán O'Brien
text: Very professional and friendly. Delivery was quick and Monika followed up a week later to make sure we were getting on well with the TM7.

author: Sinéad Walsh
text: Great experience overall. The cooking class was fun and I learned a lot of handy tips. Would have liked a little more time on bread recipes.

author: Tomasz Nowak
text: Best decision for our busy family kitchen. Monika explained all the promotions clearly and helped us set up Cookidoo on the spot.

author: Emma Kelly
text: I was unsure at first, but after the demo I was completely convinced. Monika's support since buying has been fantastic.

author: Declan Byrne
text: Helpful advisor with lots of knowledge. The machine is brilliant and the free gift with the promotion was a nice bonus.
